verdict.rationale: `pnpm install` covers everything the project declares. It installs all declared dependencies across a monorepo from a single lockfile and links workspace projects in the same install [docs-6, docs-46]. It also switches to the declared `packageManager` version on first use [docs-22], fetches the declared Node.js runtime via `devEngines.runtime` [docs-23, docs-4], and reapplies persistent patches on every install [docs-3]. CI frozen-lockfile mode keeps the result reproducible [docs-13, docs-34], and community reports confirm installs are fast and reliable [comm-3, comm-12]. missing for 10: an explicit first-party walkthrough of bootstrapping a fresh clone, and peer dependencies are not auto-installed unless declared in `package.json` [comm-6].
